title: Weekly sales dashboard
summary: Acme needs a dashboard that reports weekly sales. The client has a fixed budget of about ten thousand dollars. Alice Smith raised the dashboard need and Bob Jones confirmed the budget.
goals: Give the sales team a weekly view of results
pain_points: Weekly sales numbers are not visible in one place

features.name: Weekly sales dashboard
features.detail: A dashboard summarising sales by week.
features.source_quote: We need a dashboard for weekly sales.

features.name: Quick timing view
features.detail: Show timing entries in a short form without speaker labels.
features.source_quote: Short form timing with no speaker.

features.name: Driver route optimiser
features.source_quote: We want the system to optimise every driver route overnight.

constraints.text: Budget is about ten thousand dollars
Must integrate with the legacy SAP system
constraints.source_quote: It has to plug into our legacy SAP system.

action_items.text: Share a sample of the weekly sales data
